products.name: SP secure
description: SP Secure is a portable gas leak detector designed to ensure user safety and protect industrial facilities by detecting gas leaks early in environments with a constant risk of explosion.

With only two-button operation, it offers easy handling and sensor calibration. The %LEL and concentration levels of flammable gases (such as LPG, LNG, and hydrogen) are displayed clearly on a digital LCD monitor.
When gas concentration exceeds the safety threshold, a loud alarm and warning icon alert workers immediately.
Equipped with a built-in suction pump, alarm On/Off control, and customizable alarm settings, SP Secure adapts effectively to various working conditions and gas types.
With fast response time and high accuracy, SP Secure is the optimal solution to prevent explosions and reduce asphyxiation risks caused by gas exposure.

Fabrication is the action or process of manufacturing or inventing something.
Fabrication is using processes to create component parts can be use to make product or structure. As well as the process of constructing an item from standardised parts.
Example of fabrication is Steel. Steel will go through a fabrication process first before becoming a tool with a new function, such as becoming a steel frame.
What is Chemical Cleaning?

Chemical Cleaning is a method to derive surfaces and walls of equipment, pipelines, vessels, kettles and heat exchangers of unwanted minats. Chemical cleaning also means the purification, conditioning, treatment or disinfection of water.
What is Rental Welding Chamber?

Rental Welding Chamber or Welding Habitat is tents for project pipe welding facilities that are vulnerable to gases that can cause fires. By using a Welding Habitat or Chamber Welding, this possibility will be very small because this tent is equipped with a gas detector.

blocks.text: In a high-risk environments relevant to gas exposure, the role of authorised gas tester (AGT) is essential in testing for and ensuring safe working condition to prevent any accident.

To attend this course, there are no prerequisites required. All 16 participants at the maximum per class are expected to be personnel that are authorised gas testers. However, the class being undertaken may vary depending on the workplace operation, complexity and responsibility. Accordingly, the AGT role has been split into three levels: AGT Level 1, AGT Level 2 and AGT Level 3. Following are further explanation of each level:

items: AGT Level 1, is required for those involved with performing a test for oxygen, flammable and toxic gases up to and including working in confined spaces. To successfully complete this course, participants must be able to understands and demonstrate the following elements: Prepare to carry out a test for oxygen, toxic, and flammable gases in confined spaces. This element is a discussion on worksite preparation regarding test and identification the correct gas detector for the particular area/ environment. Complete gas tests for oxygen, toxic, and flammable gases in confined spaces. This element is a discussion on gas test completion according to manufacturers’ and company requirements. Prepare to carryout a test for flammable gasses in preparation for hot work. This element is a discussion on worksite preparation regarding test and identification the correct gas detector for the particular area/ environment. Complete the gas test for flammable gasses. This element is a discussion on gas test completion according to manufacturers’ and company requirements. Monitor the work area for flammable gasses. This element is a discussion on how to perform effective and efficient monitoring process and deliver its report accurately in timely manner.

AGT Level 2 is required for those involved with testing for flammable gas in preparation for hot work. To successfully complete this course, participants must be able to demonstrate an understanding of the following elements:Prepare to carryout a test for flammable gasses in preparation for hot work. This element is a discussion on worksite preparation regarding test and identification the correct gas detector for the particular area/ environment.Complete the gas test for flammable gasses. This element is a discussion on gas test completion according to manufacturers' and company requirements.

AGT Level 3 is required for those who provide safety watch duties by the ongoing monitoring of a hot work site. To successfully complete this course, participants must be able to demonstrate an understanding of the following elements:Monitor the work area for flammable gas. This element is a discussion on how to perform effective and efficient monitoring process and deliver its report accurately in timely manner.

blocks.text: H2S (hydrogen sulphide) is a gas formed by natural biological processes that poses a serious threat to people or assets due to its extreme toxic and corrosive properties. It is essential for any relevant personnel to be competent in emergency response practices necessary for them to stay and work in an environment with potential for exposure to H2S gas.

To attend this course, there are no prerequisites required. However, all 16 participants at the maximum per class are expected to be personnel that are, or could be, working in an environment that could become contaminated by H2S gas.
After training completion, participants are expected to fully capable in explain and demonstrating the following:

items: Hydrogen Sulphide roots
Other names, properties and characteristics for H2S
Measurement parameter and exposure limits to H2S
Types of detector equipment and respiratory equipment.
Pre-use checks of personal detection devices and EBA.
Operating personal H2S detection equipment.
Responding to an alarm.
Donning & operating an escape breathing apparatus (EBA) with a mask and a hood.
Connecting to a pressurised cascade breathing system with an activated EBA subject to correct donning.
Disconnecting from a pressurised cascade breathing system with an activated EBA subject to correct donning.
